name: Airwindows Consolidated
description: The full Airwindows effect collection in one plugin install.
about:
Hundreds of Airwindows effects — compressors, saturators, reverbs, EQs and tone-colour tools — packaged as a single plugin with a built-in browser. Known for simple, transparent algorithms and a focus on sound over interface.

Built by the Airwin2Rack project, which also powers the VCV Rack module.
notes: Pinned to the DAWPlugin release tag, which publishes date-stamped builds (YYYY-MM-DD). The version is the build date, so an update is offered only when a newer date build appears. The Windows installer is Inno Setup (verified by signature).
